chart: B Terrain Chart, MP Entrance Cost of the Halftrack and Truck columns
boundary: The Halftrack and Truck MP Entrance Cost cells of the Open Ground, Road, and Grain rows, read from a rendering. Every other row and column, and the notes the cells cite, are outside this transcription; a vehicle's entry of any other terrain is refused (ruling R25.3).
reading: A road hex entered through a road hexside costs 1/2 MP, 1 MP for a BU AFV ("1/2 [BU:1]"; D2.16); a road hex entered otherwise is Open Ground apart from its road (B1.11).
